testCase.name: [本地] S27 No lost work on toggles: two quick ticks on one patient both stick, and a task added meanwhile survives a toggle

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S27 「勾选不丢工作：同一个病人上两次很快的勾选都生效，期间加的任务在一次勾选之后还在」 No lost work on toggles: two quick ticks on one patient both stick, and a task added meanwhile survives a toggle

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 One consolidated in-app end-of-day view lists every open task across all of the physician's patients, each attributed to its patient（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U2 On the view the list is grouped by patient, pending tasks first and completed tasks at the bottom; every task shows which patient it belongs to（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-07；UAT 3.3；TFA-92585 AC 12） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Fresh @roundai.test account on the local stack; one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident on Today's Visits, three open tasks each

When (a) On /rounding/tasks click 'Mark task done' on two tasks of the same patient without waiting between the clicks; same on /snf/tasks; poll rounding:list / snf:list. (b) Open /snf/tasks, then add a task to the same resident through snf.update from a second client (as Save & Extract in another tab would), then tick a d …

Then (a) Both ticked tasks are stored done and shown completed; the third stays open. (b) The task added by the other writer is still stored and shown; the ticked task is done; no completed task reverts and no open task is lost

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：From U1 / U2: no open task lost, no completed task reverted. Judged on the stored tasks (rounding:list / snf:list, polled until stable for 5 s) and on the screen after a reload. Risk from the code: onToggleTask (TasksOverlay.tsx lines 99–123) writes the whole tasks array built from the rendered list with patch {tasks: newTasks}

在哪跑：本地 newspec-b（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S27 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-07.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；Allure 状态按分诊从 failed 改成 broken。

问题分类：票没到 ready for qa · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92585 ready for pr

同一个病人的两个任务快速连着打勾，刷新后第一个又变回未完成；在另一个标签页刚加的任务，紧接着打勾时可能会消失。

Ticking two tasks of the same patient in quick succession leaves the first one open after a reload, and a task added from another tab just before a tick can disappear.

依据：newspec-b, 3 repeats each. With no gap, the first tick is lost 3/3 in both modes. With a 400 ms gap on local both stick, but with 250 ms of latency each way (a phone network) the first tick is lost 3/3. In (b) the added task or the tick is lost in 4 of 6 runs. Cause: onToggleTask writes the whole tasks array, and PR #106's TasksOverlay still does. This is a real defect on main, predicted in the TC-07 risks but not recorded in the dev report or ledger. The report's evidence links use unsuffixed names; the files are …-rep0..2.json in runs/2026-10-14-local/newspec-b/evidence/tc07-s27/.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-b。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：newspec-b。

UAT item: TC-07 Task Export · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-07/S27

No lost work on toggles: two quick ticks on one patient both stick, and a task added meanwhile survives a toggle

Tickets: TFA-92585 Task Export (ready for pr)

本地新 lane newspec-b：newspec-b/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（newspec-b/plan.json，automatable: yes）：Chromium spec, fresh account: Hospital patient (3 tasks) and NH resident (3 tasks). (a) two 'Mark task done' clicks without waiting on /rounding/tasks and /snf/tasks, poll list until stable 5 s, reload and check the screen. (b) open the tasks view, add a task through rounding:update / snf:update from the API (second writer), tick another task on screen, read back. Added after review: (a) also with a person-like ~400 ms gap between the ticks, and that gap again over a 500 ms round trip (sync socket delayed 250 ms each way, support.ts slowSync); all run with --repeat-each=3 and evidence per repeat (…-rep<N>.json) with the measured click gap / tick delay after the write. — Plain browser + backend mutation; no extra capability.

Detail:

Re-run 16:58–17:00 with --repeat-each=3 and evidence per repeat (…-rep<N>.json), plus a slow-link variant at 17:29. (a) Two ticks with no wait between the clicks (measured gap 0 ms; both clicks done within ~70 ms): the first tick is lost 6/6 (Hospital 'Repeat BMP in the morning', NH 'Recheck INR Friday' open in the store and on screen after reload). Same two ticks 400 ms apart on localhost (measured 403–405 ms): both stick 6/6. Same 400 ms gap over a 500 ms round trip (every sync-socket message delayed 250 ms each way, as on weak hospital cellular): the first tick is lost 6/6. (b) Another writer (API, the physician's JWT) adds a task, then a different task is ticked: ticked 13–30 ms after the write, the added task ('Follow up blood cultures' / 'Repeat CBC next week') is lost 5/6 (Hospital rep1, rep2; NH rep0–2; Hospital rep0 kept it); ticked after the added task shows (57–117 ms), both survive 6/6. The earlier run's unsuffixed files are kept under evidence/tc07-s27/_earlier-run-unsuffixed (one of them came from a passing repeat).

产品问题：On Task Export (both modes), a second tick made before the first tick's write has come back from the server undoes the first: the task the physician ticked is open again after reload. On a good connection this needs two taps within the round trip (localhost: lost with no gap, kept 6/6 at 400 ms), but over a 500 ms round trip two ticks 400 ms apart lose the first one 6/6. Likewise a task added from another tab or device is dropped if the physician ticks a different task before the new task has appeared on this screen (lost 5/6 at 13–30 ms after the write; kept 6/6 once it shows). Breaks TC-07 U1/U2 (no open task lost, no completed task reverted). Cause: TasksOverlay.onToggleTask writes the whole tasks array built from the rendered list (patch {tasks: newTasks}) with no optimistic update.

证据：附了 30 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A: our own planned Playwright spec (runnerGaps 9, not written yet) is local-stack only: a fresh account plus backend.mutation / backend.query need the admin key, which dev does not have, so the dev run leaves it to the local run (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
